description: Restore a deleted repository by id (from gluecron_list_deleted_repos) before its restorable_until date: git data, LFS objects, issues, PRs, collaborators and webhooks come back exactly as they were. Cancelled CI runs stay cancelled and stopped webhook deliveries are not re-sent. Refused when another repository now has the same name in that namespace. Owner (personal owner, or an org owner) or a site admin; needs 'admin' scope. Audited as repo.restore. Returns {restored: true, id, full_name}.
name: gluecron_restore_repo
